text:
tanvi: deploy-bot just flagged eu-dedicated canary p95 +190ms during change window.

deploy-bot: alert: canary.p95=700ms (+190ms) over 5m; client_err_rate +1.5%. Suggested action: PAUSE rollout. auto-rollback suppressed for change-window.

oscar: Which commit likely caused it? We had the new kernel-fallback toggle + minor telemetry bump.

mike: kernel-fallback toggle included. Local perf looked ok but no multi-az soak.

ops_oncall: Since auto-rollback is off, suggest manual mitigation: staged traffic split (50/50) back to prior stable and pin canary for investigation.

tanvi: Agree. Also loop CS + legal before we send EA customer note.

deploy-bot: helper commands:
`redwood traffic set --pool eu-dedicated --route default --split 50:50 --to v2.3.20,v2.5.0`
`redwood pin --instance canary-eu --version v2.5.0`

oscar: Applying 50/50 now.

deploy-bot: action started (requested by oscar). rollout id: r-654321-01

oscar: Applied. live monitor: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/eu-dedicated/r-654321-01

mike: Tailing logs: `gpu_sync_delay` and `kv_cache_miss` concentrated on hosts running v2.5.0.

cs_eu: Draft message for EA: "We observed higher tail latency during canary; we've routed some traffic to prior stable while engineering investigates. No data loss. Live monitor: <link>. Ops contact: ops_oncall." Legal, ok?

legal: quick review: wording fine, avoid SLA statements.

tanvi: Decision: keep 50/50 split, pin canary, open targeted revert PR for kernel-fallback toggle. If p95 doesn't recover to baseline within 20m, escalate to full rollback.

mike: Opening PR now and will run canary-only redeploy on green. PR: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/4711

deploy-bot: canary redeploy gated by CI and health checks. auto-rollback remains suppressed for this window.

oscar: +10m update: overall p95 dropped to 510ms; v2.3.20 ~495ms, v2.5.0 ~700ms. Signal clear.

mike: PR merged and canary redeploy scheduled. Monitoring closely.

ops_oncall: +20m: post-revert canary p95 back to ~480ms, errors normalized. Keeping split for an hour soak, then re-roll remaining traffic if stable.

tanvi: Add a short note in release notes: temporarily disabled kernel-fallback toggle; added multi-az soak step to rollout checklist.

mike: Will update PR with release note snippet and perf checklist.

tanvi: Closing thread for now. Reopen if regressions recur. :thumbsup:
